summary: 37 prop meshes. Round 2 (12 Nov 2026): 24 of them now carry a unique bake from a high-detail source (BC / N / ORM, E where lit; true metal in ORM.B; subsurface and translucent slot kinds; non-overlapping UV0): the four light sources, candle alias, barrel, chest (+ new opened-lid variant SM_Chest_Small_Open_PR), two crates, long and round table, bench, stool, chair, bed (cloth-simulated blanket and pillow), four pots, two sacks (cloth simulation), skull and bones scatter. 13 props are still round-1 tiling sets with vertex-colour weathering (gravestones, fireplace, basket, pie, potion flask, counter, post, cabinet, pillar, rubble, bottle shelf). Two decal texture sets (blood splat, burn hole) are in Props/Decals. Nothing is claimed photoreal where known_weaknesses lists faults, which is every asset.
review: Round 2: Props/review/r5 and r6, per baked prop: sun and sky at the game camera (45 degrees down from 6 m), a 1 m close-up, a warm dim interior light (plus the opened chest and a skull side view), 96 samples on the GPU, looked at and criticised two to five rounds each (counts in known_weaknesses). Round 1 props: review/r1-r4. The decals were judged on a flat lit preview (Props/Decals/preview.png), not in Cycles.

validator.result: 37 assets, 21 pass, 20 errors, 169 warnings. All 24 baked props pass except three PIVOT errors that are by design (SM_Prop_Torch_Wall_01 wall-mounted, SM_Prop_Lantern_Hanging_01 hung from its hook, SM_Chest_Small_Open_PR keeps the closed chest's pivot). The other 17 errors are on the 13 unbaked round-1 props: UV_OVERLAP (tiling UVs, by design), PIVOT on the three gravestones, SLOTS_OVER on SM_Gravestone_Broken_PR.
validator.warnings: baked props: TEXEL_DENSITY above target on small props (2048 or 1024 px on a small object), TRIS_OVER_TARGET by 12-20 triangles on SM_Skull_PR and the candle

not_done: Round 2 did not reach, in the coordinator's order: fireplace (no soot bake, ash bed, firedogs or ember mask), gravestones, pie, basket, sign posts and doors (Structures/Misc untouched), and of the not-reached list everything except the two decals: beach shells / starfish / conch (Terrain/Scatter not taken over), fruit tree, hand tools, snake pillar, idol, fountain, free-standing arch, gold piles and coins, food, bookcase and empty shelf, hearts and pickups, shop sign, farm tools. No broken barrel states. Nothing imported into Unreal by this agent; the baked props need new materials per integration.contract.round2_material_upgrades (same asset names, pivots and bounds within millimetres; slot names changed to one MI_<Asset> per baked prop, see integration.assets).

contract.uv: UV0 already carries the tiling: one UV unit is one repeat of the set (tile_size_m is the nominal size the UVs were laid out for; small blocks use up to 2x denser UVs). Sample BC, N, ORM and H at UV0; sample Macro at UV0 / 7. Do not rescale.
contract.textures: BC sRGB; N linear OpenGL (flip green on import); ORM linear (R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metallic = 0); H linear 16-bit height, used 0..1; Macro linear 512 px (R large, G medium, B small variation).
contract.vertex_colour: FBX vertex colour set 'Grime', linear RGBA float, exported with every LOD. R = dirt and damp, G = moss / algae, B = bleaching (silvered oak, lichen, dressed stone, fresh straw), A = material switch (see below; 1 everywhere else).
graph: base = BC * tint * (1 - macro + 2 * macro * Macro.R)
dirt_mode multiply: c = lerp(base, base * dirt, fd * dirt_amount);   dirt_mode mix: c = lerp(base, dirt * (3 * luminance(base) + 0.35), fd * dirt_amount)
fb = saturate(B * saturate(0.9 * H + 0.35));   c = lerp(c, pale * (2.2 * luminance(c) + 0.55), fb * pale_amount)
fm = saturate(4 * ((G + 0.5 * Macro.B) - (0.55 * H + 0.62))) * (G > 0.02);   c = lerp(c, moss * (0.9 * Macro.G + 0.55), fm)
roughness = lerp(ORM.G, moss_roughness, fm) - 0.10 * fd;   normal = N;   metallic = 0

alpha_switch materials only: A < 0.875 lead (only where alpha_lead is true): colour (0.15, 0.16, 0.17) * (0.7 * Macro.G + 0.65), roughness 0.42, flat normal;  A < 0.625 (A < 0.75 where alpha_lead is false) black iron, charred wood, burnt straw or unlit void: colour (0.016, 0.015, 0.014), roughness 0.5 + 0.42 * R (iron has R = 0, char has R = 1), normal kept;  A < 0.25 window glass: colour glass_tint, roughness 0.06, flat normal, opaque (the pane mesh is faceted so each quarry reflects differently; a dark closed box stands behind it). Values written: 1, 0.75, 0.5, 0.
alpha_soot materials only: fs = saturate((1 - A) * (0.7 * Macro.G + 1.0));  c = lerp(c, (0.012, 0.011, 0.010), fs);  roughness = lerp(roughness, 0.97, fs)
contract.fbx: One FBX per asset beside the manifest: mesh objects <asset>_LOD0, _LOD1, _LOD2 (import as one static mesh with three LODs) and UCX_<asset>_LOD0_NN convex hulls; metres with UnitScaleFactor 100; Z up, front -Y; smoothing by edge (import normals); material slots in the order of each module's "materials" list. Family meshes are visual only (ART_STANDARD section 5).
contract.props_note: Props use the structure contract unchanged. Slot materials on the WroughtIron set (MI_Prop_Iron) use dirt_mode mix: R is rust, B is bright wear. alpha_switch materials on props: A 0.5 marks forged nail heads, lock plates and unlit voids (crate interiors, eye sockets, wick), A 0 on MI_Prop_PotionGlass_* is the tinted opaque glass.

round2_material_upgrades.metal_tiling: Tiling props (not baked): every material whose entry has "metal": true (MI_Prop_Iron) is METALLIC. metallic = 1 - saturate(fd * dirt_amount) (rust, vertex colour R, is dielectric); base colour of the clean iron = BC * (0.55, 0.56, 0.6); where fb (vertex colour B, worn bright) > 0: base colour -> (0.5, 0.49, 0.47), roughness -> 0.3, metallic 1. On alpha_switch materials the A < 0.625 'black iron' region (nail heads, lock plates, straps) is metallic = 1 - R with base colour (0.075, 0.075, 0.085), roughness 0.45 + 0.45 * R. The Blender preview materials in Props.blend still show these dielectric; the baked props below carry true metal in ORM.B.
round2_material_upgrades.baked: Baked props (asset entry has "baked"): NO vertex colour, NO tiling sets. Every slot of the asset samples the SAME unique texture set at UV0 (non-overlapping): T_<Asset>_BC (sRGB), T_<Asset>_N (linear, OpenGL +Y: flip green on import), T_<Asset>_ORM (linear; R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metallic: real values, iron and steel are 1 with rust 0), and, when listed, T_<Asset>_E (sRGB emissive colour 0..1; emissive = E * emissive_nits * flicker; set the multiplier to 0 for an unlit state). Slots differ only in shading model, given by slot kind.

slot_kinds.subsurface: wax / tallow: Subsurface (or Subsurface Profile) shading model, subsurface colour = BC * 0.9, mean free path about 8 mm (params.sss_radius = RGB radii in metres), opaque
slot_kinds.translucent: glass / horn panes: thin translucent, two-sided, no refraction needed. Horn: Translucent or Two Sided Foliage style with opacity 0.75 and transmission colour = BC; glass: Translucent, opacity 0.35 + fresnel, tint = BC. Emissive from E as for the other slots (the horn panes of a lit lantern glow through E). The mesh carries dink_translucent (Nanite off).

round2_material_upgrades.glass_and_embers_not_baked: Props still on tiling sets (asset entry has no "baked"): SM_Potion_Flask_PR: the alpha 0 region of MI_Prop_PotionGlass_* is the glass; give that material a translucent variant (opacity 0.35 + fresnel, tint = glass_tint, roughness 0.06, two-sided) and the flask reads as glass with the dark liquid box behind it. SM_Shelf_Bottles_PR bottles are glazed earthenware, opaque by design. SM_Fireplace_Fieldstone_PR has NO ember mask yet (not reached in round 2): light the hearth with an engine fire effect.
round2_material_upgrades.decals: Props/Decals (decals.json): T_Decal_BloodSplat_* and T_Decal_BurnHole_*, 2 x 2 atlases, BC alpha = opacity; see the 'decals' block of this manifest.
round2_material_upgrades.texture_caps: Baked props ship 2048 px (prop) or 1024 px (prop_small and the lantern). Props that dress a family as scatter are capped at 1024 by ART_STANDARD section 4: list T_<Asset>_ in Content/Dink/Data/Art/texture_import_caps.json to cap on import if wanted; the source stays 2048.
